simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַלְמָה (H5959) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַלְמָה (ʻalmâh) means a lass (as veiled or private) First listed occurrence: Exod 2 8.

definitions.full: H5959. almah עַלְמָה noun feminine young woman (ripe sexually; maid or newly married); — ׳ע Gen 24:43 (J), Exod 2:8 (E), Prov 30:19 ; Isa 7:14 ; plural עֲלָמוֺת Psa 68:26 ; Song 1:3 ; 6:8 ; עַלעֲֿלָמוֺת to (the voice of) young women , either literally, or of soprano or falsetto of boys: 1Chr 15:20 ; Psa 9:1 (read לַבֵּן עַלעֲֿלָמוֺת [for לַבֵּן עַלמֿוּת ], ' voce virginea a pueris decantandum,' Thes), 46:1 ; Psalm 48:15 (read עַלעֲֿלָמוֺת [for עַלמֿוּת ]; translated probably to 49:1 ).
